description: Implement the second batch of 5 features: Arah Kiblat (Qibla Direction), Juz Amma quick access, Surah Favorit, Kalkulator Zakat, and Hadits collection. These features extend the app with compass/device orientation, curated surah lists, financial calculator, and hadith content.
steps: 1. Add Arah Kiblat page (<section id='kiblat-page' class='page'>) in index.html: Display a compass that points toward Mecca (Kaaba coordinates: 21.4225, 39.8262). Use Device Orientation API (window.addEventListener('deviceorientation')) to get device heading. Calculate Qibla bearing from user's GPS location using the formula: qiblaAngle = atan2(sin(lonKaaba - lonUser), cos(latUser) * tan(latKaaba) - sin(latUser) * cos(lonKaaba - lonUser)). Show a compass rose SVG/CSS that rotates. If device orientation is not available (desktop), show a static arrow with the calculated angle and a message. Request geolocation for user position. Add route #kiblat to the router.

2. Add Juz Amma page (<section id='juz-amma-page' class='page'>) in index.html: Show a filtered list of Juz 30 surahs (surah 78-114). Reuse the existing surah card rendering pattern from the home page. On load, filter allSurahsCache (or fetch all surahs) to only surahs 78-114. Each card navigates to #surah/N. Add a header explaining this is Juz 30 / Juz Amma. Add route #juz-amma to the router.

3. Add Surah Favorit page (<section id='favorit-page' class='page'>) in index.html: Show quick-access cards for popular surahs: Yasin (36), Ar-Rahman (55), Al-Waqi'ah (56), Al-Mulk (67), Al-Kahfi (18), Maryam (19), Taha (20), Al-Fatihah (1). Display with same surah card pattern. Each navigates to #surah/N. Add route #favorit to the router.

4. Add Kalkulator Zakat page (<section id='zakat-page' class='page'>) in index.html: Simple zakat mal calculator. Input fields: total harta/savings (number input with Rupiah formatting), nisab info displayed (currently ~85 gram emas, show approximate value). Calculate: if savings >= nisab, zakat = 2.5% of total. Show result clearly. Add a note explaining zakat mal rules briefly. Include gold price reference (can be static approximate or fetched). Style with form inputs matching the app's design. Add route #zakat to the router.

5. Add Hadits page (<section id='hadits-page' class='page'>) in index.html: Embed a collection of at least 20-25 popular hadith. Each hadith has: id, narrator/source (e.g., HR. Bukhari, HR. Muslim), title, arabic text (if available, or just the Indonesian text), translation in Indonesian. Display as expandable cards grouped by topic or just as a scrollable list. Topics: iman/faith, ibadah/worship, akhlak/character, ilmu/knowledge, daily life. Add route #hadits to the router.
6. Add routes for all 5 new pages to the router in js/app.js: #kiblat, #juz-amma, #favorit, #zakat, #hadits. Add page elements to the pages object. Create load functions for each page.

7. Add CSS styles for new pages: .kiblat-compass (circular compass UI with rotating arrow), .juz-amma-header, .favorit-grid, .zakat-form + .zakat-input + .zakat-result, .hadits-card (expandable similar to doa cards). Follow existing design variables and patterns.
8. Ensure the More page grid (from FEAT-001) includes navigation items for all 5 new features with correct icons and hash links.
acceptance_criteria: Arah Kiblat page shows compass direction to Mecca (works with geolocation permission)
Juz Amma page shows surahs 78-114 with correct surah cards that navigate to detail
Surah Favorit page shows curated popular surahs that navigate to detail
Kalkulator Zakat correctly calculates 2.5% when savings exceed nisab
Hadits page shows at least 20 hadith with source and Indonesian translation
All new pages accessible from More menu
All new pages support dark mode
Hash routing works correctly for all new pages
verification: Open index.html and navigate to each new page via More menu
Verify Kiblat compass renders (may show static direction on desktop)
Verify Juz Amma shows exactly surahs 78-114
Verify Surah Favorit shows the curated list and cards are clickable
Test Zakat calculator: enter 100000000, verify result shows 2500000
Verify Hadits page shows hadith collection with source attribution
